narrative.overview: Two sibling systems at equal weight: Melon Files, a flat dusty-pink lab-notebook wiki, and the near-black gold-accented React site.
keyCharacteristics: Wiki: ink-on-pink, serif body, condensed Archivo headings, grid paper on hubs, flat.
Site: charcoal ground, one gold accent, Outfit headings, glow-on-hover cards.
Each system has exactly one accent and never borrows the other's.

rules.name: The Two Palettes Rule
rules.body: Dusty rose belongs to Melon Files, gold belongs to the React site. Neither crosses over.

rules.name: The Flat Wiki Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on wiki surfaces at rest or hover.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose in the wiki stays near 40em; tables, code, figures and diagrams may use the full width.

dos: Do keep each system self-contained: rose and ink for Melon Files, gold on charcoal for the site.
Do use the band for orientation on every wiki page, and the trace after H2s.
Do keep wiki surfaces flat and radii at 6px.
donts: Don't use gold in the wiki or dusty pink in the stringing pages.
Don't add drop shadows or glows to wiki surfaces.
Don't put grid paper behind long-form notes; it is for hubs only.
